lines.t: Good morning, this is Neha from Dravix General Insurance. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Am I speaking with Mister Arjun Rao?
Yes, speaking.
I'm calling about your car insurance renewal, which is due on the twentieth of this month.
Okay. What will the premium be this year?
Your renewal premium for the Honda City is eleven thousand four hundred rupees, including your no claim bonus.
That's fine. By the way, my wife also has a car, a Hyundai i20, and her insurance is with another company.
lines.label: cross_sell

lines.t: Okay, noted. Shall I send the renewal payment link to your registered mobile number?
Yes, please send it. How do I pay, can I use UPI?
Yes, the link supports UPI, cards and net banking.
Great, sounds good. I will pay tonight.
Thank you, Mister Rao. Have a nice day.

title: Health sales – skipped recording disclosure and risky claim promise

lines.t: Hello, this is Rahul from Dravix Health. You had enquired about health insurance for your family.
Yes, I filled a form on your website last week.
Great. For a family of four with five lakh cover, the Gold plan premium is around eighteen thousand rupees a year.
lines.label: compliance_disclosure

lines.t: Hmm. My father has diabetes. Will his claims be paid?
Don't worry sir, with us claims are always approved, it is guaranteed. No questions asked.
lines.label: compliance_risky_statement

lines.t: Really? Even for diabetes from day one?
Yes sir, one hundred percent, you have nothing to worry about.
Okay. My parents also have no insurance right now, actually.
lines.label: cross_sell

lines.t: Okay. Shall I send you the proposal form?
Let me think about it. Please call me back tomorrow evening.
lines.label: callback_need

title: Collections – rising frustration and payment difficulty

lines.t: Good afternoon, this is Priya from Dravix Finance. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mister Vikram Singh?
Yes.
Sir, your loan instalment of eight thousand two hundred rupees was due on the fifth and is still pending.
I know. I already told your colleague yesterday that I will pay next week.
Sir, can you please confirm the exact date you will pay?
I told you already, next week. Why do you keep calling me every day?
Sir, I understand, but I need a confirmed date for our records.
This is the third time this week. This is ridiculous, I am really fed up with these calls.
lines.label: frustration

lines.t: Sir, if the payment is late, a penalty will apply.
Look, I lost my job last month and money is tight. I am trying my best.
lines.label: payment_difficulty

lines.t: I see. Can you pay at least part of the amount today?
No, I cannot afford it right now.

title: Noisy line with ambiguous phrases – no nudges expected

lines.t: Hello, this is Kavya from Dravix Health, and this call is recorded for quality purposes. Is this a good time?
Yes, it's fine, no problem at all.
I'm calling to confirm your policy renewal next month.
Sure. Sorry about the noise, the traffic here is really frustrating today.
No worries. Your premium stays the same as last year.
Okay, good. I'm not worried about the price.
Do you have any changes to your address or nominee?
No changes. I sold my second car last year, but that's a different policy anyway.
Understood. I'll send the renewal reminder by email.
That's fine, thank you.
